main_measure.name: mean of allocation x (10-bar return - 10 x coin mean daily return) over non-overlapping 10-bar blocks, before costs
main_measure.threshold: confirm if mean > 0 with t >= 2; reject if mean < 0 with t <= -2; else inconclusive; needs >= 30 nonzero-position blocks

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of excess 10-bar return on allocation, nonzero-position blocks

decided_by: The t-statistic lies between -2 and 2: inconclusive.
reading: Blocks start at rows 0, 10, 20, ... of each window and need a full 10-bar return inside the window; the pooled mean and t use all such blocks (zero-position blocks contribute zero products) as the plan pools across coins and blocks; the coin's mean daily return is the mean of its within-window close-to-close returns over all its windows.
